The company says it believes schools should have control over AI in classrooms. Parents and teachers have criticised the policy, describing the requirement as a form of corporate pressure.

stories.title: US school closures accelerate

research.title: A Taxonomy-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Retrieval Effectiveness and Fairness Evaluation in Hiring

We address this challenge by introducing a taxonomy-driven, fully synthetic HR dataset and benchmark to simultaneously. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Same Facts, Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions

We audit three remedy-decision systems using sociolinguistic rewrites of US consumer financial complaints. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
